name: Path of Exile: Secrets of the Atlas
storyline:
Meet Eagon, an intelligent man of mysterious heritage. He is trying to discover his origins, but in doing so, he has found more than he bargained for.

In his investigation, Eagon has encountered distortions of reality. Occasionally he catches a glimpse of a young girl through the rifts - Zana. He knows her as the daughter of the great inventor who shaped the Atlas as we know it. These tears in reality, he has discovered, are actually threads of memory, distorted and made real by the Atlas.

Eagon is adamant to discover what is causing this and save Zana.
summary:
In Path of Exile: Secrets of the Atlas, tears have begun to appear in the Atlas leading to different realities. The Originator of these realities has entangled themselves within the very fabric of the Atlas and they’re now trapped! Track down the source of the tears and uncover the secrets within.

The new expansion introduces an additive endgame storyline, a new type of endgame crafting mechanic, three new endgame bosses, a new challenge league, dozens of new unique items and much more.
